🚨TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Clarenville RCMP advises that police and emergency crews are responding to a disconnected tractor trailer on the Trans Canada Highway near Churchills – approximately halfway between Goobies and Hillview. The vehicle is blocking both lanes of traffic, and the road is impassable in both directions at this time. 

Road conditions in the area are very poor and deteriorating. Whiteout conditions are present, making driving in the area extremely hazardous. Please consider delaying any non-essential travel. If you must travel, please exercise caution and patience and take your time.

Updates will be provided when available. 

#nltraffic
